Prometheus metrics HTTP tile with /metrics endpoint and boot timestamp gauge.

# Purpose
This file defines the `metric` tile for a topology-based C application. It starts an HTTP server that exposes Prometheus metrics on the `/metrics` path, and it connects that server to the rest of the runtime through the tile life cycle functions [`privileged_init`](<#privileged_init>), [`unprivileged_init`](<#unprivileged_init>), and `run`. The tile uses `fd_http_server` to accept requests, `fd_prometheus_render_all` to write all metrics into the response body, and `FD_MGAUGE_SET` to publish the boot timestamp as a metric value.

The file also defines the tile resource policy. It sets the HTTP server limits, the scratch memory layout, the allowed file descriptors, and the seccomp filter rules for the metric process. The [`populate_allowed_seccomp`](<#populate_allowed_seccomp>) and [`populate_allowed_fds`](<#populate_allowed_fds>) functions restrict the tile to the log file, the HTTP listen socket, and standard error. The `fd_tile_metric` object at the end exports the tile definition so the runtime can create and run the metrics endpoint as part of the larger system.
